Name: Haran
Summary: Haran was a son of Terah and the brother of Abraham and Nahor, and the father of Lot, Milcah, and Iscah.
KeyStory: Haran died young in Ur, before his father Terah, leaving his son Lot to travel with Abraham.
LifeLesson: A short life can still shape the story: Haran's children carried his name forward.
